attributes.title: Subdivision
attributes.lede: Drag a seam. The grid is the sizes you leave.

lesson.concept: Direct manipulation and settlement need different rules
lesson.why: During a seam drag, instantLayoutTransition applies pointer-driven layout immediately. On release the rounded track sizes update outside that wrapper, letting the same layout participants spring into place.
lesson.experiment: Drag a seam slowly, then release between round percentages. The seam should track the finger exactly and only the final correction should spring.
lesson.pitfall: Smoothing every pointer update makes the handle lag; making every update instant also removes the useful release settlement.
lesson.combine: Combine with reorder when users can both resize regions and rearrange their contents.
